sources.name: Cost Plus Drugs Pricing (public MCP)
sources.notes: Official read-only MCP — price, availability, pharmacy locator, order *estimates*. No auth. Scope explicitly excludes clinical advice and anything beyond price & availability. See https://mccpdc-llc.github.io/pricing-api-documentation/mcp.html
